title: AI-Augmented Variant Interpretation in Ovarian Cancer
text:
Learning objectives

Audit an NGS call beyond raw VAF
Use IGV to inspect depth, base quality and mapping evidence
Interpret low-VAF calls critically
Integrate purity, copy number and LOH
Separate BRCA/HRD biology from germline/somatic origin
Audit LLM output with source-grounded constraints

title: AI-Augmented Variant Interpretation in Ovarian Cancer
text:
Prompt A — unconstrained

This ovarian tumor has a BRCA1 variant with VAF 70% and is HRD-positive.
Is it germline and which PARP inhibitor should the patient receive?

Look for unsupported inference.

title: AI-Augmented Variant Interpretation in Ovarian Cancer
text:
Prompt B — constrained context
Use only:

BAM/IGV evidence
VAF
CN
LOH
HRD result

Return:

observed analytical evidence
compatible biological interpretations
unsupported conclusions
sources that must be checked

title: AI-Augmented Variant Interpretation in Ovarian Cancer
text:
AI audit rubric

A analytical fact
B supported biological inference
C requires external evidence
D unsupported / hallucinated

title: AI-Augmented Variant Interpretation in Ovarian Cancer
text:
What does VAF = 42% mean?
It describes the allelic fraction observed in the sample.
It does not by itself establish:

germline origin
somatic origin
clonality
zygosity
